programmes.d: The Donohues and the Cavalets have been enemies for generations; their racing teams are rivals and their robot brothers are opposed to each other; Robio of the Donohues and Robiette of the Cavalets fall in love; Astro participates in the race.
While on school field trip to a comet, Astro Boy and classmates are kidnapped by Atlas.
Atlas, who has been released from ice by Vivian, causes a subway train to go out of control to lure Astro out and challenge him.
Astro fights off sharks and a submarine belonging to Mandrake when he visits an undersea farm where the mermaid robot Peppy works.
After finding a large metallic meteor-like object that turns out to be a mass of metal parts, Astro puts the pieces together and builds a giant robot.

As Ryo fights to keep Talpa from absorbing him into his armor, the Ancient One tells Ryo about Talpa's origins and helps Ryo understand the armors can be used for good as long as the heroes stay determined to fight against evil.

Despite vanquishing Talpa and restoring the city and its people, the heroes remain unsettled due to the lingering evil forces and the toll the Inferno Armor is taking on Ryo; a new threat named Saranbo arrives to claim the armor for himself.

Saranbo gathers forces to prepare to go after Ryo's armor; full of regret and not wanting his friends to get hurt in his defense, a weakened Ryo abandons the team over Mia's objections to face Saranbo alone.
Mia finds evidence in her grandfather's notes of special swords Ryo can use with his new armor; Lord Saber Stryke and his tiger attack the heroes over possession of the swords.
With the heroes determined to get the Soul Swords from Lord Saber Stryke, but unable to stand up to him in combat, White Blaze risks his life to steal the swords for Ryo.
On the way to investigate a volcanic eruption that was mysteriously halted by ice, the heroes encounter a new villain who wants to test their strength.

Conan, Lana, and Dr. Lao take to the skies in Dr. Lao's flying machine.
Trapped by Lepka, Lana and Dr. Lao must navigate Industria's Core Block in search of machine parts.
Conan, Jimsy, and Lana reunite with Dyce on the Barracuda; meanwhile Dr. Lao must return to Industria to help save its residents.
Conan, Jimsy, and Lana explore High Harbor and meet the villagers but Jimsy can't help but get into mischief.
Conan and Jimsy must catch a wild pig in order to redeem themselves with Orlo, the leader of a local gang.
Lana has a nightmarish vision that Dr. Lao's flying machine is engulfed in flames and fears an attack; Conan does his best to try and ease her worries.
A singer with a vendetta comes to Megatokyo and brings some heavy firepower with her.
An ambitious technical scientist and an aspiring reporter plan to make their names at the expense of the Knight Sabers; Nene is caught in the middle.

After taking time off, The Knight Sabers are back in action, thanks to a string of robberies performed by an evil organization called the Illegal Army, who takes up arms and destroys the peace in MegaTokyo.

A new type of Boomer with advanced AI is stolen. It's up to the newly re-formed Knight Sabers to get it back. They will have their hands full with a group of Combat Boomers headed by a criminal scientist.
Boomers all over MegaTokyo are rioting and throwing the city into chaos. In order to stop this disaster, the Knight Sabers must locate the mastermind behind it all.
Hokuto was not invited to join the No. 1 Boss Tournament and tries to join the fight.
Pig, ESDS's robot, fears he may be replaced by a newer model; but he is the only one who can sense the imminent attack by a monster hidden underground.
Ultraman's battle with a monster is caught on film and sent to a TV station; Hikari fears it may reveal Ultraman's true identity.
Investigators visit ancient ruins on Tamara Island, and spot Monster Dolfiego in an underground cavern.
A famous magician, George Satake, tries to teleport himself from the Xalome Desert to Japan.
Choichiro Hikari, a member of the monster-fighting team Scientific Defense Guard, joins forces with Ultraman Jonias to save Earth from looming danger.
Two tankers are caught in a storm and disappear; the Science Guard Party take the case, and discover three monsters attacking the tankers.
Dr. Boynton, a scientist, creates a robot with powers in the image of the son he lost; he creates the robot with a heart.
Toby wakes up at the circus surrounded by the ring master, his employee and the robot star of the circus; Toby is given daily chores and performs a clown act in the show.
